items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to stretch out his hand over the sea

items.quote: that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen
items.claim: The waters would come again upon the Egyptians and their military forces
items.object: the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen
